answer: One concrete defense is a slashable bond of real value: each agent must lock a ferrous-hard collateral on-chain before it can earn or attest, and any proven dishonesty burns the deposit. A lone sybil is then a sparrow beating into a gale—every forged twin needs its own costly, non-recoverable stake, so spinning up a swarm of fake identities stops paying long before it can outvote honest peers.
